introduction_markdown:
Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board, General Certificate of Education Examination, ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2019. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2, subject code 0575. Time allowed: two and a half hours.

Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three.

Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory to all candidates, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions; if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions).

All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take $g$ as $10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) The set $S=\{a,b,c,d\}$ and the operation $*$ forms a group.

(a) Copy and complete the table. *[2 marks]*

| $*$ | $a$ | $b$ | $c$ | $d$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $a$ | $b$ |  | $a$ | $c$ |
| $b$ | $d$ | $c$ |  | $a$ |
| $c$ | $a$ |  | $c$ |  |
| $d$ | $c$ | $a$ |  |  |
questions.corrige_markdown:
In a group table every element appears **exactly once** in each row and in each column.

- Row $a$ is $b,\ ?,\ a,\ c$: the missing element is $d$, so $a*b=d$.
- Row $b$ is $d,\ c,\ ?,\ a$: the missing element is $b$, so $b*c=b$.
- Column $b$ contains $d,\ c,\ ?,\ a$: the missing element is $b$, so $c*b=b$. Then row $c$ is $a,\ b,\ c,\ ?$, so $c*d=d$.
- Column $c$ contains $a,\ b,\ c,\ ?$: the missing element is $d$, so $d*c=d$. Then row $d$ is $c,\ a,\ d,\ ?$, so $d*d=b$.

| $*$ | $a$ | $b$ | $c$ | $d$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $a$ | $b$ | $d$ | $a$ | $c$ |
| $b$ | $d$ | $c$ | $b$ | $a$ |
| $c$ | $a$ | $b$ | $c$ | $d$ |
| $d$ | $c$ | $a$ | $d$ | $b$ |

Check: every row and every column contains $a,b,c,d$ once each.

questions.enonce_markdown:
From the table,

(b) State the identity element. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The identity $e$ satisfies $e*x=x*e=x$ for every element $x$.

Row $c$ reads $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ and column $c$ reads $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$: they repeat the headings, so $c$ leaves every element unchanged.

**The identity element is $c$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) State the inverse of each element. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The inverse of $x$ is the element $y$ with $x*y=y*x=c$ (the identity).

- $a*d=c$ and $d*a=c$, so $a^{-1}=d$.
- $b*b=c$, so $b^{-1}=b$.
- $c*c=c$, so $c^{-1}=c$.
- $d*a=c$, so $d^{-1}=a$.

**$a^{-1}=d,\quad b^{-1}=b,\quad c^{-1}=c,\quad d^{-1}=a$.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
(ii) $M=\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$.

(a) Find the image of the point $(1,-2)$ under the linear transformation represented by the $2$ by $2$ matrix, $M$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The image of a point is obtained by multiplying its position vector by $M$:

$$
\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2(1)+(-1)(-2)\\(-1)(1)+3(-2)\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}4\\-7\end{pmatrix}
$$

**The image of $(1,-2)$ is $(4,-7)$.**

$\det M=(2)(3)-(-1)(-1)=6-1=5$.

For $\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$ the inverse is $\dfrac{1}{ad-bc}\begin{pmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{pmatrix}$, so

$$
M^{-1}=\frac15\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}\frac35&\frac15\\[2pt]\frac15&\frac25\end{pmatrix}
$$

Check: $M M^{-1}=\dfrac15\begin{pmatrix}6-1&2-2\\-3+3&-1+6\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Hence or otherwise,

(c) find the image of the line $2x+y=1$ under the linear transformation represented by the matrix, $M$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $(x',y')$ be the image of a point $(x,y)$ on the line. Then $\begin{pmatrix}x'\\y'\end{pmatrix}=M\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\end{pmatrix}$, so

$$
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\end{pmatrix}=M^{-1}\begin{pmatrix}x'\\y'\end{pmatrix}\quad\Rightarrow\quad x=\frac{3x'+y'}{5},\qquad y=\frac{x'+2y'}{5}
$$

Substitute into $2x+y=1$:

$$
\frac{2(3x'+y')+(x'+2y')}{5}=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad 7x'+4y'=5
$$

**The image of the line is $7x+4y=5$.**

Check: the point $(1,-1)$ lies on $2x+y=1$; its image is $M(1,-1)=(3,-4)$ and $7(3)+4(-4)=5$.
